title: Whispers of Waves

outfit_card.silhouette: Asymmetrical mermaid evening gown featuring structured seashell-scalloped bustier lines, sculpted wave-form hip drapes, and an undulating cascade of organza ruffles pooling into a fitted silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Delicate floral branch tiara adorned with sculpted crystal blossom clusters, dangling pearl strands, and matching silver-set teardrop chandelier earrings framing the face.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Asymmetrical strapless neckline trimmed with frothy translucent organza ruffles, encrusted with intricate pearl beadwork over a boned corset bodice, paired with sheer fingerless lace sleevelet gloves embellished with pearl droplets.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Fitted sheath skirt transitioning into swirling aqueous layered flounces, decorated with fish-scale pearl embroidery along the hip, extending into a gentle floor-sweeping train paired with sheer stockings.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Bioluminescent bubble motifs, cresting sea-wave contours, marine crystal flourishes, and an ornate multi-strand pearl choker centered with an azure gemstone.
